case.summary: Case HHG-003 was opened following a customer report from customer C08623 regarding an unrecognized $49.00 purchase on card C08623-K2 via transaction 3530164. Graph analysis flagged out_of_region_use with a fraud probability of 0.90 and a verdict of fraud, identifying 2 affected transactions totaling $165.93. Initial actions recommended verification, case creation, a warning, and analyst escalation under R7 and R8 due to conflicting prosecution and defence evidence. Following analyst and customer validation responses settling the question under §6, the final actions recommended BLOCK_CARD routed L1 and CREATE_CASE under Policy R2 because the customer denied the transaction.
